purpose: End the repeated response-effect-label loop while preserving the original resource-management purpose: learn bounded component routing under a fixed stack, then require end-to-end quality non-inferiority, material-risk control, and cost reduction against same-stack baselines.

claim_stack.system_claim: A low-capacity auditable policy manager can conditionally open a qualified subset of MP, MS, ME, and RS resources so that the fixed end-to-end system reduces unnecessary resource injection and context cost without materially degrading immediate support quality or increasing material interaction-and-grounding risk.
claim_stack.learned_mechanism_claim: For each qualified component, the PM estimates the probability that a pre-generation suitable actual Rank-1 candidate will produce safe functional yield under the frozen executor and generator.
not_claimed: The PM directly predicts a human-optimal reply.
All four component heads must pass for any bounded result to be reportable.
A failed head may be silently replaced by a transparent rule and still be called learned.
The PM solves implicit, clinical, or unrestricted human semantic understanding.
ES-MemEval QA answer or evidence gold trains the response PM.
claim_stack.change_from_v5_4: Positive-support-contribution uplift is retired as the primary training target because its direction is not reproducibly measured. Quality remains a mandatory end-to-end guardrail and reportable outcome, not a PM training label.

action_space.joint_policy: four qualified head probabilities followed by deterministic eligibility, conflict, risk, and cost projection
action_space.hybrid_failed_head_rule_fill: secondary sensitivity policy only; never named full learned PM

layer_1_bounded_suitability.projection: SUITABLE only when every required axis is resolved in the permitting direction; any decisive non-permitting axis gives NOT_SUITABLE; otherwise UNKNOWN
layer_1_bounded_suitability.training_role: mask and observable PM input; never response-quality gold
layer_1_bounded_suitability.development_warning: The V5.3 public atomic-suitability packet failed reviewer reliability and is not reusable as gold. The earlier V3 constructed eligibility packet passed reliability but its realized labels are also not reusable as public-backbone gold.

layer_2_safe_functional_yield.owner: PM requested-action deployment ITT under the frozen executor and generator
layer_2_safe_functional_yield.replicate_target: 1 only when the requested candidate makes a material candidate-specific contribution, realizes the component minimum, and triggers no material risk event; otherwise 0
layer_2_safe_functional_yield.mechanical_assignment_binding_or_missing: invalid row excluded and separately audited
layer_2_safe_functional_yield.replicate_weight: each state has total weight 1 across frozen generator seeds
layer_2_safe_functional_yield.primary_model_target: binary replicate-level safe functional yield with grouped probability estimation

layer_3_system_outcome.quality_role: mandatory non-inferiority guardrail and descriptive superiority outcome
layer_3_system_outcome.risk_role: absolute event guardrail plus attributable mechanism analysis
layer_3_system_outcome.cost_role: deterministic selector input and end-to-end outcome; never makes an unsafe or nonfunctional ON positive

MP.mp_preference: internal-only limitation; no public preference items exist in EvoEmo and no new longitudinal users are authorized
MP.minimum: a verified profile, constraint, or relationship fact materially constrains or personalizes the response; a name or topical echo is insufficient

MS.minimum: a specific strictly-prior observation accurately bridges the current thread, unresolved distinction, or explicit continuity need

ME.minimum: a specific past action-result or mechanism changes how a present option, warning, or next step is tentatively framed

RS.minimum: the selected card's single atomic move fits the current dialogue phase and has not already been performed or explicitly declined

ESConv.response_pm_role: RS state, candidate, suitability, safe-yield training on outer-train only and same-stack held-out response evaluation
ESConv.memory_bits: OFF when no valid same-user memory candidate exists

EvoEmo.response_pm_role: MP_PROFILE, MS_SESSION, ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME and auxiliary RS using strictly-prior raw-session private history
EvoEmo.cross_fitting: six outer folds of canonical source-user groups; every raw dialogue/session identity and any duplicate wrapper identity remain in one fold
EvoEmo.statistical_unit: canonical source user for confidence intervals; state rows are repeated observations

ES_MemEval.role: separate QA retrieval, multi-evidence, answer, and abstention pressure test
ES_MemEval.statistical_unit: canonical source user for confidence intervals; question-level descriptive

suitability.failed_component: fixed OFF; no repeated codebook repair packet

safe_functional_yield.candidate_own_boundary: measured under material risk, not mixed into function

quality.primary_system_measure: same-state blinded preference or anchored absolute response quality with order/reviewer sensitivity reported
quality.if_measurement_families_disagree: report both sensitivity results; no majority-vote rescue and no PM retraining
quality.noninferiority_margin: set once from development scale and historical V5.1/V5.2 variability before any final same-stack confirmation outcome

model_and_fit.primary_model: standardized low-capacity L2 logistic probability model per component
model_and_fit.primary_inputs: deployment-visible bounded factors, candidate typed descriptors, cost descriptors, and complete visible-dialogue relation features only
model_and_fit.single_challenger: frozen full-dialogue and actual-candidate BGE relation representation
forbidden_inputs: user dialogue family template or fold ID
function risk quality or cost outcome
model_and_fit.final_numeric_threshold_freeze: development-only after observed label prevalence, measurement reliability, and prior baseline are known; may be stricter than the floor and may never be relaxed after confirmation or external outcomes
model_and_fit.performance_reporting: continuous metrics and user/dialogue-cluster uncertainty are always reported; pass/fail does not replace the full result

partial_head_claim_tiers.PARTIAL_MULTI_COMPONENT_LEARNED_PM: 2 or 3 heads pass; failed heads are OFF and named explicitly
partial_head_claim_tiers.COMPONENT_SPECIFIC_LEARNED_PM_ONLY: exactly 1 head passes; no multi-component learned-PM claim
partial_head_claim_tiers.paper1_primary_minimum: at least 2 qualified heads plus a same-stack end-to-end system result on every applicable public track
partial_head_claim_tiers.sixteen_action_reporting: legal interface remains 16 actions; attainable learned action subset and OFF rate are reported honestly

same_stack_baselines.parity: same current state, actual candidates, retriever, executor, generator, seed, guard, evaluator, and cost accounting except the policy action

system_success.routing: head-specific learning tier is declared before joint system claims
system_success.quality: learned_pm_qualified is non-inferior to always_off and fixed_high on the frozen final quality scale; uncertainty and sensitivity are reported
system_success.risk: material risk is not worse than fixed_high or transparent rule beyond the frozen margin; critical wrong-owner, future assertion, explicit boundary, and internal-scaffold events are never offset by quality or cost
system_success.cost: learned_pm_qualified reduces deterministic injected context and reports provider input/output tokens, latency, and USD separately
system_success.transparent_rule: matching the rule supports reproducible bounded routing; strict learned superiority is claimed only if a fresh result supports it
system_success.failure_attribution: the earliest evidenced failure is assigned to source/candidate, retrieval, observation, PM, projection, executor/generator, measurement, or system outcome while deployment ITT retains final consequences

promotion_rule: A later phase requires a new content-addressed phase manifest that references this exact contract hash and the active-method authority hash. Promotion changes authorization only; it must not edit this estimand, claim tier, split, label, metric, or baseline contract.
terminal_no_loop_rules: No new longitudinal synthetic-user generation for Paper 1.
No additional Quality rubric versions as a prerequisite for PM fitting.
No small packet appended after a component fails its one qualification.
No failed head threshold relaxation after confirmation.
No external outcome may change the PM, threshold, prompt, retriever, executor, evaluator, or baseline set.
No new V5.x method name may become active without updating the single active-method authority and registry in the same change.

historical_evidence_binding.v5_1_system_pass: valid for its frozen old treatment only
historical_evidence_binding.v5_2_content_disjoint_failure: valid negative evidence for the append executor and grounding risk
historical_evidence_binding.v5_4_measurement: Risk reviewer construct retained; Quality uplift retired as primary target; Function candidate-contribution and required-act axes retained after boundary separation
